Name: Evelyn Carter

Work Experience:
- 2023--2023: Physics Research Intern, Quantum Innovations Laboratory. Assisted senior researchers in conducting experiments related to quantum entanglement and photon measurement. Analyzed experimental data using Python and MATLAB, contributing to the refinement of data collection techniques. Prepared laboratory equipment and ensured compliance with safety protocols during high-voltage tests. Collaborated with a multidisciplinary team to design simulations of quantum phenomena. Presented findings at weekly group meetings, receiving constructive feedback for further improvements.
- 2022--2022: Physics Teaching Assistant Intern, University of Northbridge Department of Physics. Supported undergraduate physics courses by assisting professors during lectures and laboratory sessions. Provided one-on-one tutoring for students struggling with classical mech
